long_biography.plain_text:
Winning the licence for Resorts World Sentosa turned Lim Kok Thay's inherited Malaysian casino business into a major international resort operator. Genting opened the Singapore complex in 2010, followed by properties in New York and Las Vegas. The expansion placed entertainment, hotels and attractions around the group's established gambling operations.

After studying civil engineering in London, Lim joined Genting and worked across the family group before succeeding his father as chairman in 2003. He spent nearly two decades as chief executive before moving to executive chairman, separating board leadership from daily management. His record also includes an ambitious cruise venture: he built Genting Hong Kong around Star Cruises, although the company entered winding-up proceedings after the pandemic.
